spatial_contract.output_settings: Existing Master/Effects/range/mono once; no ducking lease, music hold or interior gain.
spatial_contract.mute_zero: Stop tails immediately; caption/history survive eligible contacts; no replay after unmute.
spatial_contract.missing_stream_or_effects_bus: Silence with spatially eligible caption/history; no Master fallback.
spatial_contract.acoustic_limit: Exterior Euclidean approximation only; no wall occlusion, elevation, acoustic paths or propagation delay.

caption_contract.on_screen: Inclusive actual viewport bounds; material phrase only

caption_contract.retained_owners: All eight previous owners/timers intact; cancellation clears only new line.
caption_contract.layout: Extend only caption panel upper bound as needed; nine wrapped lines, independent controls at both viewports.

history_contract.entry: Local sequence plus generic contact caption only; no timestamp, coordinates or actor ID.
history_contract.clock: Bounded active presentation time; finite delta [0,0.1].
history_contract.limited_contact: Discard entry without queue; audio/current caption unaffected even if wording changes.
history_contract.ordering: Insertion order; evict oldest; detached read-only copy
history_contract.ui: Separate Nearby footstep cues section in existing selectable scrollable Recent sound cues view; preserve reply section/data and keyboard/focus return.
history_contract.pause_focus_overlay: Retain old entries; freeze rate-limit clock; cancel new cue presentation
history_contract.successful_load_teardown: Clear own entries/sequence/limiter with no replay; other owners untouched

lifecycle.successful_load: Reset new presentation and clear only new history
lifecycle.range_loss: Stop only ineligible tails/current caption; physical cadence still consumes future valid samples.
